title: Page Audit Tool output
description: One dataset row per page that answered with an HTML body (rowType page), plus one summary row at the end of every successful run (rowType summary), plus a SUMMARY record with the same totals.

pages.title: Audited pages and run summary
pages.description: One item per page, with rowType page: url, status, title, titleLength, titleMissing, metaDescription, metaDescriptionMissing, h1Count, headingOrderBroken, imagesWithoutAlt, formFieldsWithoutLabel, canonical, canonicalMissing, issues and issueCount. The last item of every run is the rowType summary row: pagesCrawled, pagesAudited, pagesSkippedByRobots, pagesWithIssues, totalIssues, the count per defect category and a plain English message, written even when no defect was found.

summary.title: Run summary record
summary.description: startUrl, pagesCrawled, pagesAudited, pagesSkippedByRobots, pagesWithIssues, the count per defect type, totalIssues, worstPages (up to ten), durationSeconds, chargedEvents, chargeLimitReached and chargeFailures.
